35747.question_text: The period of a simple pendulum X is 5s. What is the period of a simple pendulum Y which makes 50 vibrations in the same time it takes X to make 20 vibrations?
35747.explanation:
It takes X 5s for 1 complete vibration.

⇒ It takes X (5 x 20)s for 20 vibrations.

= 100s.

It takes Y 100s for 50 vibrations.

⇒ The period of Y = \(\frac{100}{50}\)s

= 2s.
